logp.method_description: The lipophilicity of compounds (1–4) was determined using the shake-flask method in a system of two immiscible solvents: n-octanol and 0.9% NaCl aqueous solution. The solvents used were previously saturated for 7 days. Solutions of complexes (1–4) were prepared in n-octanol at a concentration of 0.06 mg mL-1, and the absorbance was measured at 294 nm for (1) and (3) and 298 nm for (2) and (4). In the next step, the compounds were shaken for 30 min with 0.9% NaCl aqueous solution at a 1 : 1 (v/v) ratio, and the absorbance at the same wavelength was measured. LogP values were calculated from the difference in the concentration values of the solutions before and after shaking with 0.9% NaCl aqueous solution. The analysis was performed in five replicates.
